articles.title: SC to hear bail pleas of Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam in Delhi riots case
articles.description: The Supreme Court is slated to hear on Wednesday pleas of activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid challenging a Delhi High Court order denying them bail in an Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) case related to the alleged "larger conspiracy" behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots. As per the cause list, a bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana is likely to hear the matter. In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry. The petition by Imam contended that the chargesheet was filed on September 25, 2020, in which 18 accused face trial and the prosecution has cited more than 900 witnesses, including 47 protected witnesses.
